## Pull Request Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it addresses.

Fixes #(issue number)

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an identified QA issue)
- [ ] New feature / enhancement
- [ ] Hardware / Circuit documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring / Non-blocking optimization

### Quality Assurance Verification
- [ ] Hardware tested on physical circuit or Wokwi simulator
- [ ] Unit / Functional verification passed
- [ ] RCA (Root Cause Analysis) documented and attached
- [ ] No regression introduced into other peripherals
